intent.zh: 按 Chief 2026-11-11 指令并入 A-1a/A-1b/RE-0 复核低项处置：①一般项 G1——含 tile 分支的 identical 站点（A-1a resident_mass_factor_派生:accumulation:0、A-1b resident_mass_substitute:accumulation:0）改判 not-decidable（reasons no-lineinfo/frozen-artifact-only，note「tile 分支设备级不可判，A1/RE-1 覆盖」）；②低项 ①A-1a missing_evidence 2603→303；②A-1a README §3 4 条待复核与 requires_decision 3 条不一致→补 accumulation:2 前提项；③词表引用统一为现版 46282084…/4,867；④RE-0 residual_diff_types 6 条与 README 5 类统一（合并同类项并说明两措辞）；⑤RE-0 §5 补 codegen 脚本含本机绝对路径（移植需改）；⑥RE-0 说明 a1_* 脚本用途（A1 codegen 路线）；⑦统一措辞「归一化指令流等价」。全部 append-only（A-1a/A-1b/RE-0 的既有 evidence/README/receipt 字节不改，新增 addenda.md + 重算派生 manifest）；新增小证据目录 qa-cross-slice-addenda 记录 8 项处置与落点。零 GPU、零窗；不改 src/tests/fixtures/scripts/判据/参考/容差。
intent.en: Per Chief's instruction, handle the A-1a/A-1b/RE-0 review findings: general item G1 - the identical sites whose coverage text includes the tile branch (A-1a resident_mass_factor_derived:accumulation:0 and A-1b resident_mass_substitute:accumulation:0) are reclassified as not-decidable with reasons no-lineinfo/frozen-artifact-only and a note that the tile branch is device-level undecidable and covered by A1/RE-1; seven lows: A-1a missing_evidence 2603->303; A-1a README section-3 four items vs three requires_decision entries -> add the accumulation:2 premise item; unify the vocabulary reference to the current 46282084.../4,867; unify RE-0 residual_diff_types (6 entries) with README '5 classes' wording; RE-0 section-5 note that codegen scripts contain local absolute paths; explain the a1_* scripts; unify the wording 'normalized instruction stream equal'. All append-only: existing evidence/README/receipt bytes unchanged; new addenda.md files plus derived manifest recomputation; a small qa-cross-slice-addenda evidence dir records the 8 dispositions. Zero GPU/window; no src/tests/fixtures/scripts or criteria changes.

acceptance: `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1a/addenda.md` append 新节：G1 改判（`resident_mass_factor_派生:accumulation:0` identical→not-decidable，reasons no-lineinfo/frozen-artifact-only，note tile 分支设备级不可判、A1/RE-1 覆盖）；低项① 2603→303（6×48+15）；低项② 补第 4 条待复核（accumulation:2 identical 前提）；低项③ 词表现版 `46282084…`/4,867 取代 `fcbec8f9…`/4,560；措辞统一「归一化指令流等价」。A-1a evidence.json/README/receipt 字节不改。
`docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-a1b/addenda.md`（新文件）：G1 改判（`resident_mass_substitute:accumulation:0` identical→not-decidable，同 reasons/note）；词表版本更新；措辞统一。A-1b 既有字节不改。

`docs/development-evidence/np-gate/re0/addenda.md`（新文件）：residual_diff_types 6→5 统一口径（合并「no arithmetic difference」两措辞、保留映射说明）；§5 补 codegen 脚本含本机绝对路径（开发用、移植需改）；说明 a1_* 脚本对应 A1 codegen 路线；措辞统一「归一化指令流等价」。RE-0 既有字节不改。

`docs/development-evidence/np-gate/qa-cross-slice-addenda/`：README（8 项处置清单、状态、落点、旧→新引用）+ receipt（verdict=PASS、corrections_total=8、reclassified_sites=2、tree.head、gates、boundaries）+ manifest 自核；UTF-8/LF/无 BOM。
A-1a/A-1b/RE-0 三处 manifest 按新文件重算（派生），既有文件条目 sha 不变（除各自新增 addenda.md）。
边界：写域仅 `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/**` + `.normify/**`；`unchanged src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/`、`scripts/`；不改判据/参考/容差；零 GPU、零窗。
四门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit + `normify check`；中文提交。
note: Chief 2026-11-11 指令（QA 对 A-1a/A-1b/RE-0 复核 PASS + 1 一般项 + 低项）；独立小卡处置，不改已验证卡的历史字节；QA 可只读复核 addenda 与 manifest。
